items.title: Bradford teens join trial cutting social media time
items.summary: Born in Bradford recruits 4,000 secondary students for an IRL study on limiting social media, to inform the UK’s planned under-16 ban.

items.title: Classroom phone bans raise grades in large trial
items.summary: A Science study of 16,683 Indian college students found lecture phone bans lifted GPA, with the biggest gains for lower performers.

items.title: US bill would stop chatbots acting human with kids
items.summary: Bipartisan House bill makes a non-personified mode the default for minors: no claimed feelings, guilt-tripping, or relationship-building to keep kids engaged.
